sloka: तौ प्रसार्योरगभोगकल्पौ भूजौ भुजङ्गारिनिकाशवीर्यः।जगाम मेरुं नगराजमग्र्यं दिशः प्रकर्षन्निव वायुसूनुः ।। ६.७४.५१ ।।
transliteration: tau prasāryoragabhogakalpau bhūjau bhujaṅgārinikāśavīryaḥ।jagāma meruṁ nagarājamagryaṁ diśaḥ prakarṣanniva vāyusūnuḥ ।। 6.74.51 ।।

translations.english: Observing the ocean whose waves were made to revolve round (by his speed), exceedingly, whose creatures were made to whirl round violently (by the wind force generated by his speed), he went forth like the wheel loosened from Vishnu's hand.
